description: Accept/reject corpus for the spec-lint claim-line parser. The double pin between specs/README.md section 4 grammar prose and parser.rs. Each entry: line (as it would appear inside a '### R<group>' body), group, verdict ('accept' | 'reject'), and for rejects the rule id expected. Consumed by crates/spec-lint parser tests under the cargo-tests gate.
